---
name: wos-review
description: Reconcile ongoing projects and actions into daily or weekly operational reviews and identify manager/team reporting material.
---
# WOS Review
1. Read `AGENTS.md`, run `python -m wos review`, and inspect registry/project sources.
2. Review open/proposed, blocked, waiting, overdue, and done items. Verify source evidence before status changes.
3. Weekly: capture achievements with evidence; next-week priorities; missing project-owner updates; unverified status; decisions needed; cross-team dependencies.
4. Suggest draft reminders, status requests, manager updates and peer agendas as files; do not send them.
5. Never mark a project green merely because no risk is recorded; say *unknown/stale* when data lacks freshness.
6. When an external status update arrives, reconcile to the existing project rather than making a duplicate.
7. Return what needs your attention versus what can be delegated, using record/source IDs.
